title: Watchlist add-skeleton — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #132 (frontend-watchlist-add-skeleton), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: WatchlistTable.tsx's synthetic pending-add row is given `added_at: ''` (an empty string, not null/undefined). DataTable.tsx's sort comparator (`compareForSort`/`isMissing`) only treats null/undefined as 'missing' (always sorted last) -- an empty string is compared normally via localeCompare, and `''` always sorts before any real ISO date string. So while the 'Added' column is actively sorted ascending (the table's own default GET order, oldest-first), the skeleton row renders at the TOP of the table instead of in a stable position, and the instant the refetch completes and the real row (with today's -- the newest -- timestamp) replaces it, ascending sort now puts it LAST: the row visibly jumps from top to bottom the moment its data loads. Sorting descending has the mirror-image issue (skeleton at the bottom, real row jumps to the top on resolve). Fix by giving the synthetic row a sentinel that sorts like the actual newest value (e.g. `new Date().toISOString()`) instead of `''`, so its position stays stable across the pending-to-real transition.

WatchlistTable.tsx's `WatchlistRow` doc comment (just above the type definition) says 'Every column's `render` below swaps in an animated MUI `Skeleton` for this row', but the action column (keyed `confidence_band`) actually renders `null` for a pending row, not a Skeleton (correctly -- there's no remove action for a not-yet-real row). The comment overstates the actual per-column behavior; worth tightening so a future reader/maintainer doesn't expect a Skeleton in every cell including the action column.

decisions.decision: Give the synthetic pending row's `added_at` the pending mutation's own `submittedAt` timestamp (`mutation.state.submittedAt`, already read via the same `useMutationState` call that supplies `pendingTicker`), converted to ISO via `new Date(submittedAt).toISOString()`, instead of computing `new Date()` inline at render time.
decisions.rationale: The checklist's own suggested fix (`new Date().toISOString()`) works for the sort-stability goal but, if computed inline in the component body, recomputes to a slightly different value on every re-render while the row is pending -- not wrong (still always sorts as 'newest'), but an unstable value for what should be a fixed synthetic field. `submittedAt` is a stable, TanStack-Query-owned timestamp already scoped to that one mutation call (set once when `mutate()` fires, present on every version of @tanstack/react-query in package.json), so reusing it needs no extra state and stays constant for the row's entire pending lifetime. It's always at or slightly before the server's own `added_at` for that same POST (the server timestamps after the client has already submitted), so the synthetic row keeps sorting as the newest entry in both directions -- last ascending, first descending -- matching exactly where the real row lands once it replaces the skeleton, eliminating the jump. Rejected: leaving `new Date()` computed at render time (works but needlessly non-deterministic across re-renders); deriving a sentinel purely from `items` (e.g. `items` max `added_at` plus 1ms) -- rejected because it couples the pending row's sort key to the *existing* rows' data shape/values instead of the mutation's own lifecycle, and produces a wrong ordering if `items` is empty or none of its dates are recent.
